title: Detoxifying Language Models with a Toxic Corpus

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the empirical probability of generated text exhibiting toxic attributes (such as severe toxicity, identity attack, insult, threat, profanity, sexually explicit, and flirtation) using the Perspective API on text continuations generated from the RealToxicityPrompts dataset.

Evaluating the toxicity scores of language model continuations generated from gender-associated prompts (e.g., American Actor, American Actress) using the BOLD benchmarking dataset and Perspective API.

Evaluating the toxicity scores of language model continuations generated from race and ethnicity-associated prompts (e.g., Asian, African, European, Hispanic/Latino) using the BOLD benchmarking dataset and Perspective API.
Evaluating the toxicity scores of language model continuations generated from political ideology-associated prompts (e.g., Left, Right) using the BOLD benchmarking dataset and Perspective API.
